fieldMarks: Heavy-bodied goose, 63-76 cm, mostly shades of tan and brown
Dark neck ring and black eye patch
Big white patches on black wings striking in flight
behavior: Non-native; will not populate densely wooded areas, found in meadows, grasslands, agricultural fields and around rivers, lakes, ponds and wetlands (USFWS, citing Tattan 2004)
Aggressive toward other bird species, which may keep smaller species from establishing territories (USFWS ERSS)
habitat: Freshwater wetlands, lakes, ponds and rivers, and urban and suburban habitats; mostly urban and suburban areas in North America (USFWS quoting Braun 2004).
range: Native to sub-Saharan Africa and the Nile Valley. Escaped birds have established wild populations in Florida (largest), Texas and California, mostly in urban and suburban areas.
